name: Yang Dimension
definition: For a finite nonempty concept class $\mathcal H$, the Yang dimension is the projective dimension of the Alexander-dual Yang ideal $I^*_{\Delta_{\mathcal H}}$ over the chosen coefficient field.
parameters: A coefficient field may be specified; the value can depend on its characteristic in general.
normalization: The singleton class on the empty domain has Yang dimension zero.
comments: This is distinct from the Yang depth defect already catalogued.
